_readme: Hand-maintained corrections for scripts/extract-coffees.mjs. Everything in here was added
because of something actually observed in the r/AskAnAustralian thread 1vii42k - nothing is
speculative. Keys are matched against a normalised form of the comment body: lowercased,
accents/punctuation collapsed to single spaces, 'MelbourneCBD' split to 'melbourne cbd'.
aliases   - phrase -> place. Longest phrase wins. 'confidence' is what the extraction is
tagged with when the alias fires. Optional lat/lon override the gazetteer.
prefer    - suburb name -> state to pick when the name exists in several states and the
comment gives no hint. Encodes 'the famous one' (Collingwood is the Melbourne
one, Waterloo is the Sydney one). Resolutions via this map are 'medium'.
cityStates- capital/major city name -> state, used both to disambiguate the city itself
(Perth exists in WA and TAS) and as a state hint for other names nearby.
stateHints- extra phrases that imply a state (region nicknames, abbreviations).
stoplist  - gazetteer names that are too generic / collide with ordinary English. Matching
exclude   - comment ids dropped from the map, with the reason.
force     - comment ids with a hand-set price and/or location.

_aliasNotes.via: A region is not a suburb. 'rural NSW' / 'bayside melbourne' have no gazetteer row, so they borrow one town's coordinates through 'via' as a stand-in centroid, but keep the region's own name and carry approximate:true. Before this, eleven comments were pinned on - and labelled with - a suburb nobody in the thread ever said, and two commenters who only wrote 'rural/regional NSW' were stacked on Dubbo as if they were both there. 'Melbourne outer suburbs' also shared a jitter group with a real, explicitly-stated Dandenong purchase, so the map showed two Dandenong points where the thread has one.
_aliasNotes.naming: Names are written so that the app's 'Location, STATE' label reads properly: 'Regional, NSW', 'Far North, QLD', 'Outer Suburbs Melbourne, VIC'.

_stoplistNotes.observed: price (Price SA, 13 hits: 'the price', 'half price'), dollar (Dollar VIC: 'used to be 1 dollar'), city (City ACT: 'Brisbane City', 'the city'), broke (Broke NSW: 'if it broke'), haven (Haven VIC: "haven't"), short (Short SA: 'short black'), sale (Sale VIC: 'half price sale'), martin (Martin WA - only ever seen as 'Martin Place', which is an alias), coles/vittoria/inglewood (Coles SA, Vittoria NSW, Inglewood QLD - all appear as brand names), manly (Manly NSW - the thread's only use is 'a manly mocha', an adjective), sunshine (Sunshine VIC - only appears inside 'Sunshine Coast', which is an alias).
_stoplistNotes.defensive: springfield, kingston, prospect, cluan and the 'the ...' names are real gazetteer entries that are ordinary English words or fragments; they did not fire in this thread but would be pure noise if they did.

exclude.p2dmzxc: Home drip-machine cost breakdown ($1.50). The '$6.50 for a manly mocha' is the adjective 'manly', not Manly NSW - would put a phantom pin on Sydney's northern beaches.
exclude.p2evebr: '$10.70 total for a large Ice Latte and a Medium Long black' - a combined total for two drinks, not a single coffee price.
exclude.p2e53z4: 'Tea cost me 5.80 in Blacktown' - it is tea, not coffee.
exclude.p2dveh2: '$14.00' was a protein bar plus a coffee, not a coffee price.
exclude.p2dpf9h: Quotes 'Palm Beach GC' from the OP but the $16.50 is a ham and cheese toastie.
exclude.p2dodpr: Repeats the OP's own $7.10 to call it criminal; not an independent purchase.
exclude.p2em2sj: Repeats the OP's $7.10 as a quote, not their own purchase.
exclude.p2egyvm: Roleplay joke ('That'll be $7.10 thanks'), not a real purchase.
exclude.p2e66fi: 'It's $7 and $8' restates the parent's Brunswick Heads prices - same two cups, would double-count.
exclude.p2f5gej: 'Most places in Brisbane you're looking at minimum $5 even for a small' - a claim about the Brisbane market floor, not a coffee anyone bought (no verb of purchase, 'most places', 'minimum'). It is also mid-thread quality argument, not an answer to the OP. Its author, Boss_unicycle-560, already answers the thread at p2dkicr ('$3 from the local 7/11'), so mapping this too would count one respondent twice in the same city.

p2dkicr.name: Brisbane
p2dkicr.why: '$3 from the local 7/11' names no place. It used to inherit Brisbane from this author's own later comment p2f5gej, but p2f5gej is now excluded and an excluded comment must not donate a location. The purchase is real, and the same author saying 'Most places in Brisbane you're looking at minimum $5' is decent evidence of where they are - so keep the pin but at low confidence. Price is left as extracted ($3).

p2dkqu1.why: 'In Brunswick Heads paid 8$ for a soy flat while and 7$ for a Mocca'. The mapped $8 bought the soy flat white; the mocha was the $7 one. 'flat while' is a typo the drink patterns cannot match, so clause-binding leaves the drink blank and the only drink named in the comment is the mocha - which belongs to the other cup. Price and location are left as extracted.

_flairNotes: Subreddit flair is self-declared location the commenter attached to their own comment. It ranks below an in-text location and above thread inheritance, and is capped at confidence 'medium' because it says where the person is, not where this cup was bought. flairStoplist holds flair text that is not a location; a bare state token is refused in code.
